subject: ICT
title: Let's Categorise
subtitle: Sort things into groups
hero_picture: A Kerala kitchen: a mother and daughter sorting a mixed heap of fruits and vegetables on a table into two baskets.

sections.heading: All mixed up
text: Fruits and vegetables are all mixed up.
Let us put them in groups.
sections.caption: A mixed heap
sections.picture: A table with a mixed-up heap of fruits and vegetables: apples, bananas, mangoes, tomatoes, carrots, beans and cabbage.

sections.heading: Two baskets
text: 'Give the fruits to me,' says one basket.
Mango goes to fruits. Carrot goes to vegetables.
sections.caption: Fruits here, vegetables there
sections.picture: Two cartoon baskets with happy faces and arms: one basket full of fruits, the other full of vegetables.

sections.heading: Click, hold and move
text: How do we move a picture on the screen?
Click on it and hold the button.
Move the mouse, then let go. This is drag and drop!
sections.caption: Dragging with the mouse
sections.picture: A girl at a laptop dragging a picture across the screen with the mouse, a dotted path showing the movement.

sections.heading: Sort on the computer
text: Move letters to one side and numbers to another.
sections.caption: Sorting on the screen
sections.picture: A laptop screen divided into three plain boxes: one with letters as blocks, one with number blocks, one with small animal pictures.

sections.heading: Sort at home
text: Put balls in one box, blocks in another.
Spoons with spoons, plates with plates.
sections.caption: Sorting toys
sections.picture: Children sorting their toys into boxes: balls in one box, blocks in another, dolls in a third.

rhyme: Carrots, beans, the veggies go in,
Click and hold, then drag and drop,
Sorting is fun, I cannot stop!
activity: Sort the things in your pencil box into groups: pencils, crayons, erasers.
talk: How do we move a picture on the screen?
How do you sort your toys?
summary: We can sort things into groups; on the computer we drag and drop them.

questions.prompt: A carrot goes into which basket?
A mango goes into which basket?
To move a picture on screen, we...
questions.explanation: Drag and drop: click, hold, move, let go.
8 is a number; the others are letters.

questions.prompt: Putting similar things together is called...
questions.explanation: Sorting puts similar things in one group.
